svg.title: The holding pattern — GLM-5.3's weights gate is 3 days out, and the safety hold is also a verification hold
svg.desc: A diagram of the quiet window of August 25, 2026. Across the top, a frozen closed-model ceiling band: Claude Opus 5 at Index 63, Claude Fable 5 at 62.1, and Grok 4.6 at 60.9, unchanged for a seventh straight brief, with no Index-64 model and no flagship price cut since July 24, about five weeks. Below it, a horizontal countdown timeline with three marks: August 14, GLM-5.3 launched API-only; August 25, today, the marker labelled T minus 3 days; and August 28, the target date for the open weights to be published to Hugging Face, still not shipped and with no slip signal yet. Beneath the timeline, a two-node catch-22 loop drawn as a cycle: node one, the weights are held for safety because of an emergent exploit-chaining capability; node two, the vendor's own cyber claims cannot be independently verified until the weights are public. An arrow runs from node one to node two labelled the hold blocks the check, and an arrow runs back from node two to node one labelled the check needs the release, so the two open watch-items — does it ship, and is it verified — collapse into the same single dated event. A footer notes that nothing shipped in the window, the Intelligence Index is unchanged, and the whole board is waiting on one date three days out.
svg.text: The holding pattern — one dated event, three days out
Quietest window of the series: nothing shipped, the Index is unchanged, and the whole board waits on GLM-5.3's weights gate
❄ CLOSED CEILING — frozen a 7th straight brief
No Index-64 model · no flagship price cut since Jul 24 (~5 weeks) · Gemini 3.5 Pro still absent
The one live thread — GLM-5.3 open-weights gate
Why "does it ship?" and "is it verified?" are now the same question
Z.ai's own eval — held ~2 wks to harden
The same drop is both the resolution and the first chance to check it — three outcomes for Aug 28: full weights · a hardened/capability-restricted
checkpoint · or a slip (the way Qwen3.8-Max's open drop slipped twice). No new model shipped since GLM-5.2 Turbo (Aug 17).
